title: Grateful Dead Live at Capital Centre on 1982-09-15
lineage: CD -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Matrix recording that moves from audience‑only intro to crisp soundboard captures a high‑energy show highlighted by the debut of Touch and a rippin’ second set.
ai_review.review: The tape starts with two audience‑recorded tracks before switching to a full soundboard feed at Dupree's, delivering very nice clarity for most of the concert. Musically the night is praised for an explosive second set and a scorching first version of Touch, despite a puzzling opening sequence that some felt disrupted the early pacing.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviewers consistently note strong performance (especially Touch and set 2) and good sound quality after the initial audience tracks, outweighing minor pacing concerns.

recording_quality.technical_notes: First two songs are audience‑only and a bit raw; from Dupree's onward the recording switches to full soundboard with very nice clarity and balance.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Unusual opener (Playing > Crazy Fingers) caused early pacing questions, but the band settled into a high‑energy groove, delivering a rippin’ second set.
